verdict.rationale: The README recommends a first-party "code builder" for exploring Reader API parameter combinations, which is an interactive exploration tool. The README also offers static curl examples. Nothing shows the builder executes requests in-browser or serves as a full API reference, and the OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: evidence that examples are runnable in the reference itself, a structured interactive API reference (e.g. OpenAPI-backed explorer), and hands-on corroboration of the code builder.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: We highly recommend using the code builder to explore different parameter combinations of the Reader API.
